document.title: PMK 6/2026: PPh 21 DTP peserta pemagangan lulusan perguruan tinggi

delta.note: The regulation grants a government-borne (DTP) PPh 21 incentive only for university-graduate apprenticeship participants (Peserta Pemagangan). They receive allowances and social security contributions paid by a government agency, and their tax is computed as the Pasal 17 rate times gross income, as for non-permanent recipients. It does not change any value, rate, deduction, or calculation step for permanent employees (pegawai tetap) or company payroll.
